description: Computes deterministic readability metrics (Flesch Reading Ease for EN, Fernández-Huerta & INFLESZ for ES, Grade Level, structure score, overall score) and a CEFR-inspired Readability Band (A1–C2, not a certification).

ignoreWords.description: Optional case-insensitive list of domain/product words or acronyms to ignore when flagging complex words and undefined acronyms (team glossary).

lang.description: Analysis language code: "en" (English, Flesch Reading Ease) or "es" (Spanish, Fernández-Huerta). Defaults to "en".

markdown.description: Set true when the text is Markdown: code blocks, tables, badges, URLs and link targets are ignored so only prose is scored. Offsets still refer to the original text. Defaults to false (check_file enables it automatically for .md files).

text.description: Plain text or Markdown to analyze (non-empty, up to 1,000,000 characters).

name: analyze_text
title: Analyze Text Readability
